descriptions.vision: Clarify the purpose, audience, and outcome before shaping the solution.
descriptions.research: Gather the context and evidence that keeps decisions grounded in real needs.
descriptions.design: Turn insights into a clear structure, visual language, and interaction model.
descriptions.architecture: Structure the systems, information, and technical details behind a product.
descriptions.prototyping: Make the idea tangible early enough to learn from it and change direction.
descriptions.usability: Have a product tested by users to analyze user experience.
descriptions.release: Ship deliberately but stay open minded for improvements.
descriptions.feedback: Gather feedback as a continuous input for the next iteration.
descriptions.update: Maintain security, use feedback and stay up-to-date.
